findings.title: README headline counts are stale
findings.detail: README.md describes the old master as 312 rows total / 308 in scope / 18 sports and calls the root URL the master board. The committed canonical master now records 317 total rows / 312 in scope / 19 sport labels, while the root landing page is a six-sport desk and the consolidated board is under /board/.
findings.action: Integration request: update README counts, route descriptions, and the dated data cutoff from the canonical outputs; do not imply that an old README count is current.

findings.title: Gaelic Football scope conflicts across taxonomy records
findings.detail: data/olbg-structure.json marks Gaelic Football (OLBG sport 25) in scope; data/sports.json marks Gaelic Football excluded; all five Gaelic Football master rows are currently out of scope. This should be resolved as an explicit interpretation, not silently changed.
findings.action: Integration request: select and document one policy. The current master excludes these five rows, consistent with data/sports.json and the more literal reading of the request.

findings.title: The canonical list is a dated snapshot, not a live all-sport feed
findings.detail: The master metadata says generated_on=2026-10-21 and explicitly says values are copied from prior committed builds without refresh. The row-level freshness review counts 164 in-scope fixture rows dated on/after 2026-10-22: 150 are carried as strict rows and 14 are held for source, verification, or copy gaps. A separate fresh Board T desk adds 91 official-source fixtures for 22–28 Oct across four sports; it explicitly leaves 15 in-scope sports unrefreshed. Together these do not establish a full live fixture universe for all sports.
findings.action: Keep the cutoff visible; refresh only from official governing-body feeds, and leave unconfirmed values blank until a new source check is recorded.

evidence.label: Fresh 22–28 Oct Board T desk and coverage gaps

findings.title: Forty in-scope rows lack a classified official source
findings.detail: The canonical master has 312 in-scope rows. The row-level review classifies 40 with no official source recorded or an unclassified source; 27 additional in-scope rows have an official-domain link but no original build-verified flag; and one row is explicitly contradicted by a later live check. The canonical metadata counts 244 in-scope rows as officially verified. These other rows remain listed/flagged, not independently confirmed here.
findings.action: Do not present those rows as official confirmations. The existing Flagged for Review pages are the manual-review queue; add evidence only after the governing-body page itself is checked.

findings.title: Five High picks do not have unique human-written predictions
findings.detail: There are 38 High rows in the canonical in-scope master. 33 are marked written and 5 are marked templated. A templated prediction does not satisfy the brief's unique human copy requirement, even if it exceeds 30 words.
findings.action: Keep the five templated High records visibly flagged or downgrade them until distinct, source-checked copy replaces the templates.

evidence.label: Official EHF standings source recorded for a held pick

findings.title: The same greyhound category appears under two sport labels
findings.detail: The canonical sport list contains both 'Greyhound Racing' and 'Greyhounds'. OLBG's captured taxonomy records 'Greyhounds' as its category; the extra label appears to come from merged source builds. This audit did not assume they are interchangeable or merge records.
findings.action: Review the source-build provenance and normalize only if an official OLBG category/ID proves the labels map to the same sport.

findings.title: No fresh provider-page verification was possible in this audit
findings.detail: The audit independently rebuilt repository checks and compared committed metadata. It did not fetch OLBG, league, tournament, or governing-body pages during this turn; the provider-domain values and source URLs remain evidence inherited from committed session records, not fresh confirmations.
findings.action: Treat source URLs as links for manual review. No missing result, line, form statistic, or prediction fact was inferred or backfilled.

findings.title: Unverified values remain visible instead of being blanked
findings.detail: The master classifies 68 in-scope rows as not verified. The generated board table renders row names and any stored pick/market text without gating those cells on verification; 66 unverified rows currently have at least one such displayed value, including 43 with non-empty market fields. This differs from the brief's instruction to leave unconfirmed values blank. The data is flagged, but the values are not blanked.
findings.action: Integration request: keep the evidence/flag rows, but hide or blank every unverified value in the public fixture table until a row-level official source check is logged. Do not infer replacements.

findings.title: The OLBG fixture capture is not an exhaustive all-match feed
findings.detail: The committed reverse-engineering record describes OLBG sport pages as a server-rendered tipped-event list with additional entries behind a JavaScript Load More control; untipped fixtures are not shown until someone tips them. Therefore the captured OLBG inventory cannot by itself prove a complete fixture universe. Other merged builds add matches from their own sources, so the origin of each list remains important.
findings.action: Describe the coverage honestly as the captured tipped-event inventory; only call it a full fixture list if each governing body or league supplies a complete schedule and the comparison is documented.

findings.title: High-focus result is now board-specific: a fresh desk has eight qualifiers
findings.detail: The earlier automated-feed review reported zero picks meeting both >=70% model probability and American odds -250 to +10,000. That result is not a repository-wide current statement: the newer standalone Board T dataset contains 8 High selections satisfying both filters in its 91-row, four-sport 22–28 Oct desk. All eight have official source URLs recorded and predictions on its picks page. The desk is separate from the 317-row canonical master and explicitly does not refresh 15 in-scope sports, so it is not yet a combined all-sport list.
findings.action: Use the fresh desk's eight qualifying selections as that board's output; preserve the earlier zero result as pipeline-specific history. Do not combine or overwrite boards until the integration owner independently re-verifies the rows and source facts.
